{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
This was a '''two way HoloNet transceiver implant''' and a mind-control device duplicating the effects of [[Nihil smokestone]], allowing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] to eavesdrop on and transmit [[Triclops]]'s thoughts to Imperial probe droids while [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]].<ref name="SPIN declassified">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had Triclops plant misinformation to the Imperials and learned that rare [[Macaab mushroom]]s from [[Arzid]] could destroy the implant without damaging Triclop's mind; however the operation was never performed.<ref name="TEGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
